# express-route-inspector

A lightweight utility for inspecting and analyzing routes and middleware in an Express.js application.

## Features

- 🔍 Inspect all registered routes
- 📋 Print routes in a readable format
- 📊 Get route statistics
- 🎯 Find routes by path and method
- ⚠️ Detect duplicate routes
- 🧩 Inspect global and route-level middleware

## Installation

Install the package using npm:

```bash
npm install express-route-inspector
